en: Black‑and‑white view of a European town square dominated by a large brick church with a tall tower and clock. In front of the church stands a two‑storey gabled building with many rectangular windows and shutters, likely an inn or civic house. A few people are visible near the entrance, and young trees line the sandy open square. At the very top edge of the image, faint mirrored handwriting appears, as if from a caption on the negative.
